newsitem.title: ERITREA: Eritrea sells nine state-owned businesses.
newsitem.headline: Eritrea sells nine state-owned businesses.

text.p: Eritrea is offering nine state-owned businesses for sale with the closing date for bids on April 30, the head of its privatisation agency said on Thursday.
Tewolde Wolde Mikael said Gash Cigarettes and Tobacco was the biggest of the nine and companies from the United States, Britain and other countries in Europe and Africa had expressed interest.
He named the eight others as Fana Oxygen and Acetylene, Barka Woodworks and Plastic, Bizen Furniture, Gurae Furniture, Red Sea Soap, Asmara Wine and Liquor, Asmara Milk and Eritrea Shoe.
He said the buyers would be announced within two months of the closing date for bids. He said the next invitation for bids for state-owned businesses being privatised would be in May.

The government announced last year it would sell 39 of its industries. The ruling party, which as a guerrilla movement before independence in 1991 was Marxist for many years, says that it wants privatised enterprises to lead Eritrea's growth.
